Donald Trump is becoming even more unpopular in the UK, according to a new poll.

The US president’s approval ratings have plummeted in just a month, YouGov found.

Their latest poll tracking European voters’ views of Trump shows that just 10% of Britons have a favourable opinion of him – down from 13% in August.

Meanwhile, the number who are unfavourable towards him has risen from 83% to 85% over the same period.
